title: Inventory · client 23.1.3
hint: Complete progress slots are stored on the server. A module is stored as linked records in ModuleStorage (slot 27), ModulePoint (slot 26.c/1155), and ModulesInfo (slot 37). Direct module records in 26.s/26.u are not used. Other unverified records are read-only. Client item names are in English; a technical ID is shown when a name was not extracted. Original progress data is preserved without loss.
name: Item
equipped: Equipped — remove it in game first
readOnly: Read-only: grant format is not verified yet
technical: Technical ID — name has not been extracted yet
saved: Inventory saved; resync was scheduled only for this player
conflict: The state changed or the item is equipped. Reload inventory; remove equipped items in game first.
managePlayersHint: Profile, inventory, and moderation in separate tabs.
browseCatalogHint: Search by name, internal ID, or numeric ID.
passCurrenciesHint: Set the exact balance, not an increment: 0–2,147,483,647. Pass crowns, tiers, premium access and rewards remain unchanged.
syncHint: After saving, a full resync is scheduled only for this player.
itemSearchPlaceholder: Name, internal ID, or numeric ID
protectedHint: Revocation does not affect equipped items or unverified formats. Unknown progress data is preserved.
rawWarning: Diagnostic editor. Saving replaces all five sections; use Profile or Inventory for normal changes.
catalogHint: Names from client 23.1.3 are in English. A technical ID is shown when a name was not extracted. Unverified formats are read-only.
transferHint: Transfer replaces the recipient progress and clears the source account.
reconcileHint: Links the source identity to the target account. Two populated profiles are not merged automatically.
footer: Local console · data only through the secured API
tokenHint: Enter the administrator token. It is stored only in this tab and is never included in the page address.
bulkSyncWarning: One operation and one resync, only for the specified player. Enter the player ID to confirm.
overviewHint: Summary and quick access to management
playersHint: Choose a player to manage their progress
supportHint: Player tickets, ownership checks and account operations
logsHint: Live server event stream · up to 2,000 lines
listCount: Showing {shown} of {total}. Refine the search if the player is not listed.
emptyHint: Change the query or select another category.
revokeWarning: The item will be revoked completely. Remove equipped items in game first.
derivedPetName: Display name derived from the ID; original ID is preserved
derivedModuleName: Readable name derived from the module ID; original ID is preserved
moduleGrantWarning: Grants the module at level 1–10: its index is added to the type list in slot 27, the linked ModulePoint to 26.c/1155, and the level to slot 37. Existing parts are preserved and duplicates are not created.
petGrantWarning: Grants a new pet at the selected level from 1 to 65 without cards or a custom name. For an existing pet, only the level changes; cards, name, and all other fields are preserved.
grantWarning: The selected parameters replace current values. Consumable quantity is the final amount, not an increment.
bulkGrantHint: Adds only missing weapons with a verified format. Existing weapons, levels, and rarities are unchanged.
bulkGrantWearHint: Adds missing masks, headgear, boots, and capes. Existing items are unchanged.
bulkGrantArmorHint: Adds missing armor at the selected level. Existing armor and its level are unchanged.
bulkGrantGadgetsHint: Adds missing gadgets at the selected level. Existing gadgets and their levels are unchanged.
bulkGrantPetsHint: Adds missing pets at the selected level from 1 to 65 without cards or custom names. Existing pets and their levels are unchanged.
bulkRevokeHint: Removes supported ownership records. Equipped and unverified items remain. Currency, experience, and other account data are not reset.
bulkSaved: Operation completed: {count} changed. Resync was scheduled for this player.
discard: There are unsaved changes. Discard them and continue?
confirmRaw: Replace raw data for player {id}? This operation may change all progress.
confirmDelete: Delete account {id}? This cannot be undone. Enter the player ID to confirm.
authError: The token was rejected or access is forbidden.
stale: Progress changed. Load a fresh preview and confirm again.
needConnection: Connect with an administrator token first.
invalidNumbers: Check integer non-negative values and the allowed level.
invalidJSON: Section {section} must contain a JSON object.
bulkGrantModulesHint: Adds only missing modules at the selected level from 1 to 10. Linked ModuleStorage, ModulePoint, and ModulesInfo records are created atomically for each module. Existing modules and their levels are unchanged.
settingsHint: Theme and language for the local console
settingsDescription: Theme and language are saved only in this browser. Dark theme is always used when the saved theme is missing or invalid.
clientErrorsHint: Unity errors and progress reload stages over the last 24 hours.
diagnosticRetention: Grouped over 24 hours; up to 2,000 events retained for 7 days. Client repeats are suppressed for 30 seconds. Counters represent accepted reports, not every crash. Completions may include earlier or operator-requested revisions.
diagnosticEmpty: No events in the selected period.
mailboxHint: Global letters are available to every account, including new accounts. Each gift can be claimed once per account. Publication uses UTC; leave the date empty for now. Letters refresh on the next keepalive or reconnect. Gifts automatically use Developer Message. Look up weapon indices in the catalog.
mailboxRequired: Enter a title, summary and body in at least one language.
mailboxPublished: News published. Reconnect the client to load it.
mailboxInvalid: Check the text, UTC date, reward amounts and catalog weapon index.
mailboxFull: The 500-news limit has been reached. News was not published.
mailboxUnavailable: News could not be saved. Check server disk availability.
mailboxArchiveConfirm: Remove this letter for everyone? Unclaimed gifts will become unavailable. Granted rewards and claim records will be preserved.
mailboxSaved: News updated. Connected clients refresh it on the next keepalive or reconnect.
mailboxEditScheduled: Before publication, text, gifts and publication time can be changed.
mailboxEditLocked: After publication or a claim, only text/category can be edited. Gifts and publication time are locked; existing receipts are preserved.
mailboxConflict: This news changed in another session. Unsaved text is preserved. Copy it if needed, then reopen Edit from the refreshed list.
mailboxEditMissing: News no longer exists. Unsaved text has been preserved.
s_intro: Help with account access, bugs and questions about the game.
s_guestNote: You can request account recovery without signing in. Save the ticket number and secret access code to return from another device.
s_empty: No tickets yet. Create one or open an existing ticket with its access code.
s_forget: Forget guest access in this browser
s_formIntro: Choose a topic and complete the short form so we can help you faster.
s_noSecrets: Do not send passwords, game login codes, 2FA codes, passkeys or device IDs. There are no payments in the game; receipts are not needed.
s_optionalQuestions: Answer what you remember. If unsure, choose “I don’t know” or leave optional fields blank. Answers do not grant account access automatically.
s_old_device: Do you still have access to the previous device?
s_changed_device: Did you change devices before losing access?
s_last_login: Approximately when did you last play? (optional)
s_last_purchases: What did you buy recently in the game shop? (optional)
s_last_spending: What did you recently spend coins or gems on? (optional)
s_saveCode: Save the ticket number and secret code. The code opens only this ticket, not the game account. Do not share it.
s_copyManually: Copy failed. Save the number and code manually.
s_unlockIntro: Enter the number and secret code received when creating a ticket without signing in.
s_forgetWarning: Guest ticket access will be removed from this browser. You will need saved numbers and codes to return. The tickets themselves will remain in support.
s_ticketIntro: Support replies and the conversation history are saved here.
s_closedNote: This conversation has ended. If needed, create a new ticket and reference this number.
s_evidenceWarning: The claimed ID is not proof of ownership. Client-supplied data may be spoofed. Do not share technical identifiers with players; check several independent signals.
s_noHistory: These details were not previously recorded. New observations will appear on future sign-ins if supplied by the client.
s_walletWarning: History starts with this update and is not a complete purchase ledger. Game commands reflect accepted balance changes, not independent proof of a purchase.
support_unavailable: Support is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
ticket_not_found: Ticket is unavailable or the access code is incorrect.
ticket_changed: This ticket has changed. Refresh it before sending a reply.
s_roleHint: Allows reading and processing all tickets on the website. Does not grant the server administration token.
s_closeConfirm: No longer need help? Closing keeps the conversation history, but you will not be able to send another reply to this ticket.
